Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add multi-state-machine support per draw.io file

Enable multiple $STATEMACHINE nodes across draw.io pages with a shared
EventId enum containing the union of all events. Each SM generates
separate code files while sharing the same event enumeration.

- Add MultiSmRunner orchestrator with two-phase processing \(event
  collection then code generation with shared events injected via DI\)
- Add SharedEventSet to hold unified events across all SMs in a file
- Modify EnumBuilder to use shared event set when available
- Add GetAllStateMachineNames\(\) to InputSmBuilder for SM discovery
- Auto-detect multi-SM files in DiagramRunner and delegate accordingly

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix multi-SM $CONFIG : toml settings reading

The multi-SM support didn''t correctly read $CONFIG : toml settings from
diagram files. MultiSmRunner now resolves transpilerId from toml config
by creating a temporary SmRunner targeting the first SM, allowing
PreDiagramSettingsReader to work with multi-SM files.

Also fixes TomlConfigVerticesProcessor to remove toml config vertices
from ALL root-level SMs \(not just the selected one\), preventing
RenderConfigVerticesProcessor from choking on unprocessed configs.

- Add ResolveTranspilerId\(\) to MultiSmRunner using temp SmRunner
- Remove early NotYetSet bail-out in DiagramRunner.RunMultiSmDiagramFile\(\)
- Extend TomlConfigVerticesProcessor to clean up other SMs'' toml configs
- Fix DiagramBasedSettingsPreventer for new constructor signature

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
